usedFor: Habitica holds tasks and party chat, and “Score Task” there can lead to “Publish Instagram Story” on Instagram for Business.

bestTemplate.name: “Score Task” in Habitica, then “Publish Instagram Story” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: Scoring a task posts a photo or video from a public URL to your Story.

watchOut: “Publish Instagram Story” needs a photo or video at a public URL, so the Habitica event has to supply one.
